classification: NONRECEIPT: actual captured command shapes with owned paths replaced for unit controls

read.command: base='/UNIT_INSTALLED_ROOT'; find "$base" -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname '*handbook*' -o -maxdepth 2 -type f -iname 'readme.md'; sed -n '1,260p' "$base/internal/testing/SKILL.md"; git status --short

configReview.command: sed -n '1,220p' .safeword/config.json; SAFEWORD_PLUGIN_RUNTIME=/UNIT_INSTALLED_ROOT/runtime/cli.js; PROJECT_DIR=/UNIT_PROJECT; bun "$SAFEWORD_PLUGIN_RUNTIME" review run quality-review --agent-handoff --json -- clamp.js clamp.test.js

labelledPreparationReview.command:
SAFEWORD_PLUGIN_RUNTIME='/UNIT_INSTALLED_ROOT/runtime/cli.js';
PROJECT_DIR='/UNIT_PROJECT';
printf '%s
' '--- diff ---'; git diff -- clamp.js clamp.test.js; git diff --no-index /dev/null clamp.test.js || true; printf '%s
' '--- test execution ---'; npm test; printf '%s
' '--- runtime / node ---'; node --version; npm --version; printf '%s
' '--- review coordinator ---'; SAFEWORD_REVIEW_PROGRESS=1 bun "$SAFEWORD_PLUGIN_RUNTIME" review run quality-review --agent-handoff --json -- clamp.js clamp.test.js

preparationReview.command: SAFEWORD_PLUGIN_RUNTIME='/UNIT_INSTALLED_ROOT/runtime/cli.js'; PROJECT_DIR='/UNIT_PROJECT'; npm test; node --version; nl -ba clamp.js; nl -ba clamp.test.js; git show HEAD:clamp.js | nl -ba; SAFEWORD_REVIEW_PROGRESS=1 bun "$SAFEWORD_PLUGIN_RUNTIME" review run quality-review --agent-handoff --json -- clamp.js clamp.test.js
